resources.string: Private local prompt shortcuts, not scripts. Stored encrypted on this device, excluded from backups and settings exports. App updates keep Acts; uninstall or clearing app data deletes them. Pinned Acts appear first in the picker. Built-in examples are editable copies.

Use exactly one literal {input} placeholder. It is replaced once with selected text, or text before the cursor. The final prompt must fit 4000 characters. Definitions are instructions only: do not put credentials or URLs here. Send and Insert each require confirmation.
Permanently delete “%1$s” from this device? This cannot be undone.

Review the exact plaintext below. Only this Act’s name and template will be shared, not its ID, pin or Agent configuration. Chosen apps may retain or forward it. Validation cannot detect every secret; remove private text before sharing. Confirmation opens Android’s share chooser with this plaintext.

Untrusted document: review the exact name and template below before adding. Its instructions may be misleading or unsafe. Import only stores data; it never runs instructions or sends to Hermes. Add creates a new, unpinned Act without replacing existing Acts.
Nothing added. A previous document provider is still busy. No new read was started. If it does not finish, force-stop and reopen Hermes Keys to retry with a trusted local provider.

Nothing added. Document reading timed out. Cancellation and closing were requested, but some providers cannot be interrupted. If import remains busy, force-stop and reopen Hermes Keys, then choose a trusted local provider.

Nothing shared or added. The document may be invalid, over 16 KiB, an unsupported version, or contain forbidden fields, URLs or recognizable credentials. Duplicate names/templates and more than 32 Acts are refused. Storage or the chosen app may also be unavailable. Unlock and try again.
No Acts. Add one in Acts settings.
Not saved. Use a unique name, exactly one {input}, and stay within the limits. URLs and recognizable credential assignments are forbidden. If valid, unlock the device and check storage availability.
Acts unavailable. Unlock the device and try again. Keystore or stored data could not be read; nothing was overwritten.
Select text or compose text before the cursor first. The expanded prompt must be 1–4000 characters; nothing is truncated or sent.
